items.name: Register a learner and issue a session
items.description: Public registration stores normalized identity and a password hash, creates a learner profile and issues a session cookie. Account and session creation are separate writes.
items.goal: Obtain a learner account and authenticated session.
items.trigger: POST /api/v1/auth/register with displayName, email, password and optional locale.
preconditions: DTO validation and the register rate limit pass.
Email is not already registered after normalization.
mainFlow: DTO trims name/email, lowercases email, checks name length 2–80 and password length 12–128; optional locale must be vi or en.
Hash password, then create User and nested LearnerProfile. Prisma supplies LEARNER and ACTIVE defaults.
Create random 32-byte base64url token; store its HMAC-SHA256 hash with user ID and seven-day expiry.
Set HttpOnly, SameSite=lax cookie on path / and return projected user; registration metric is best effort.
exceptionFlows: P2002 unique constraint failure becomes email conflict 409.
Invalid DTO is 400; exceeded register bucket is 429.
Session-write failure propagates after account creation; there is no encompassing registration transaction.
postconditions: Success creates User, LearnerProfile and UserSession and exposes no passwordHash.
businessRules: Registration rate limit is 30 per 60 seconds per IP/route.
Session cookie secure is hardcoded false.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Registration returns normalized public identity and session cookie.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Duplicate normalized email cannot create a second account.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: A password shorter than 12 characters is rejected.

items.name: Log in, authorize requests and log out
items.description: Protected requests reload session and account state; effective role metadata is resolved from handler before class.
items.goal: Use an active account for protected requests and revoke the current session.
preconditions: Successful login requires an existing ACTIVE account and matching password.
Protected requests carry a decodable worklingo_session cookie.
mainFlow: Normalize email and load account/profile. Verify password hash.
Persist new hashed session and set cookie; return projected user.
SessionAuthGuard bypasses Public handlers, otherwise reads cookie and rejects absent/revoked/expired sessions or non-ACTIVE accounts.
Attach authUser/authSessionToken. RolesGuard checks any matching role against effective handler/class metadata.
GET /api/v1/me returns authUser. Logout revokes unrevoked sessions matching the current token hash, clears cookie and returns 204.
alternativeFlows: No required-role metadata passes the role guard.
Unknown email still performs a hash operation before the public credential error.
exceptionFlows: Unknown email, wrong password, inactive account or invalid session yields 401.
Insufficient role yields 403.
Malformed cookie encoding is treated as a missing token.
postconditions: A logged-out token no longer authenticates.
businessRules: Method roles override class roles; listed roles are alternatives.
Logout revokes the current token rather than all account sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Unknown email and wrong password use the same public error.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Logout prevents subsequent /me access with that session.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: A newly inactive user fails subsequent session authentication.

items.name: Create, edit, validate and preview lesson source
items.description: Drafts preserve raw source even when invalid. Compare-and-set updates bind validation to a revision and hash.
items.goal: Produce a current validated draft and inspect normalized content and issues.
items.trigger: Create import, PATCH source with expectedDraftRevision, POST validate, or GET preview.
mainFlow: Create DRAFT with exact rawSource, SHA256 sourceHash, revision 1, parser version and actor attribution.
For edit reject immutable status/stale revision; conditional update increments revision, sets DRAFT and clears validationHash.
Analyze and parse source; conditional validation matches ID, revision, sourceHash and editable status.
Persist AST, normalized preview and issue report; set VALIDATED and validationHash=sourceHash only for canPublish.
Preview uses stored normalized content when validationHash matches sourceHash; otherwise reanalyzes without persisting validation.
alternativeFlows: Invalid content remains stored as DRAFT with issue report.
Preview can show analyzable source without authorizing publication.
List/get methods ignore actor filtering; controller role gate permits shared administrative access.
exceptionFlows: Missing import is 404; immutable status or concurrent edit is 409.
Controller returns 422 CONTENT_PARSE_FAILED for PARSE_ issues or CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED otherwise after saving report.
postconditions: Validated state refers to the unchanged source/revision checked by conditional update.
businessRules: Validation cannot silently approve a newer concurrent revision.
Preview alone is not publication authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Stale validation cannot mark a newer revision VALIDATED.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Editing validated source clears its validation hash.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Invalid source remains available with issue details.

items.name: Generate and review a provider-specific audio candidate
items.description: Generation stores provider/voice/configuration variant and durable job, checking script hash before and after synthesis. An optional-dependency legacy path also exists.
items.actor: CONTENT_ADMIN or SYSTEM_ADMIN; runner and configured TTS adapter
items.goal: Create an explicit audio candidate for an authored script.
items.trigger: POST /api/v1/admin/content-imports/:id/generate-audio with idempotency key and optional script/provider/voice/config.
preconditions: Import contains requested script, or at least one script if omitted.
Selected provider is available and voice is supported.
mainFlow: Resolve provider/voice and canonicalize voice configuration into variantKey; request hash includes import ID.
Replay identical actor/operation/key receipt or reject conflicting reuse.
Select requested or first script and hash exact text; transactionally create GENERATING artifact, GENERATE_AUDIO job and acceptance receipt.
Return accepted job reference. With dispatcher/runner injected, start bounded runQueuedJob in addition to any timer polling.
Handler fetches current script and returns STALE on pre-synthesis hash mismatch; otherwise synthesize and store under generated-audio.
Recheck script after synthesis; conditionally update GENERATING artifact to READY or STALE with provider/storage/checksum metadata.
Administrative listing and authenticated streaming allow candidate review.
alternativeFlows: Identical receipt returns original acceptance response.
Without optional dispatcher the service creates lowercase generate-audio job and uses legacy in-process generation; normal module wiring imports JobsModule.
A STALE artifact is a normal handler return and can accompany a COMPLETED job.
exceptionFlows: Registry rejects unavailable provider or unsupported voice; missing script/import is 404.
Retryable provider error keeps artifact GENERATING until budget exhaustion; terminal/exhausted errors attempt FAILED and rethrow.
Unexpected synthesis/storage errors propagate to runner policy.
postconditions: Generated candidate is not automatically published.
Job COMPLETED is distinct from artifact READY.
businessRules: Script hash and provider/voice variant identify the generation.
Publication later selects an explicit READY candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Old text cannot become a fresh READY candidate after script change.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Identical generation request replays its original response.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Fresh candidate records actual provider, checksum and storage metadata.

items.name: Publish a validated version and archive a version
items.description: Publication locks by lesson slug and rechecks the draft within its transaction before materializing versions, audio bindings, audit and replay receipt.

evidence.symbol: describe("Transactional publish, archive, and session version isolation")
describe("Transactional publish, archive, and session version isolation")

items.goal: Expose a complete lesson version with selected audio or retire a published version.
preconditions: Current expected revision/hash, idempotency key and selected audio map supplied.
Import VALIDATED for its current source; listening scripts have matching READY candidates.
mainFlow: Check actor/operation/key receipt; replay matching hash or reject conflicting reuse.
Check revision/hash/validation/report, fresh normalization and audio readiness/hash/ownership.
Transaction takes advisory lock on normalized lesson slug, rechecks receipt, row-locks/rereads import, and rechecks selected artifacts.
Upsert lesson, allocate version and word-bank versions, schema-validate snapshot and materialize version, blocks, activities, word-bank links and audio bindings.
Archive former current version, publish new version, move current pointer and mark import PUBLISHED.
Commit PUBLISH_LESSON audit and receipt with publication; emit best-effort metric afterwards.
Explicit archive uses slug lock, accepts PUBLISHED or existing ARCHIVED, clears pointer only if still current and records ARCHIVE_LESSON audit.
alternativeFlows: Identical waiter replays receipt after lock.
Already archived version returns ARCHIVED without a duplicate archive audit.
No listening activities requires no listening audio selection.
exceptionFlows: Missing resource is 404; stale revision/hash, published state or conflicting key is 409.
Invalid validation or missing/foreign/non-READY/stale/extra audio selection is 422.
Snapshot schema/database exceptions roll back transaction.
postconditions: Publication atomically points lesson at complete PUBLISHED version and archives prior current version.
Explicit archive may leave current pointer null; it does not choose an older version.
businessRules: Publish request hash omits importId; cross-import replay is a separate inferred gap.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Concurrent identical publication creates one version and receipt.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Different keys cannot publish the same draft twice after its state changes.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Archiving current version clears pointer and records one audit.

items.name: Claim, execute, recover and retry a persistent job
items.description: PostgreSQL locking coordinates claims; owner/attempt identity fences job updates. Automatic retry preserves identity and manual owner retry grants one additional attempt.
items.actor: In-process runner; creating administrator for status/manual retry
items.goal: Process durable work with bounded retry and recover abandoned claims.
items.trigger: Timer poll, direct runOnce invocation, or owner POST /api/v1/jobs/:id/retry.
preconditions: Due PENDING/RETRY_WAIT below attempt budget, or RUNNING with expired lease.
Registered handler needed for successful dispatch.
Status/retry API requires administrative role and matching createdById.
mainFlow: Enqueue skips duplicate keys and confirms creator/type/resource identity against existing row.
Transaction selects one eligible row FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, prioritizing expired RUNNING work then availableAt/createdAt.
Expired claim marks running attempts FAILED with LEASE_EXPIRED; exhausted budget marks job FAILED, otherwise new RUNNING claim increments attempt and sets owner/expiry.
Dispatch handler; success updates only RUNNING job with same owner/attempt and marks attempt SUCCEEDED.
On error store safe code/summary; eligible retryable ProviderError receives bounded jittered backoff or job becomes FAILED.
Owner manual retry conditionally accepts FAILED/retryable, sets PENDING, increments maxAttempts by one and clears completion/error state.
alternativeFlows: No eligible claim returns false. Expired final attempt can be failed while claimNext returns null.
pollActive prevents overlapping timer polls only, not direct runOnce calls.
Automatic retries retain job ID and increment attempt on next claim.
exceptionFlows: Unknown type fails without retry.
Stale completion/failure returns false after owner/attempt changes.
Non-owner job appears not found; non-retryable state or lost retry race is 409.
postconditions: Accepted claim creates numbered attempt; accepted completion/failure sets its outcome.
Job update fencing does not establish exactly-once external side effects.
businessRules: Live leases excluded from claims; completion predicate does not test leaseExpiresAt.
Manual retry budget is separate from automatic retry.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Concurrent claimers obtain at most one claim per row.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Reclamation rejects previous attempt completion.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Retry cannot claim before availableAt.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Manual retry keeps job identity and adds one maxAttempts unit.

items.name: Resolve evaluation preference and call configured adapter
items.description: Factory selects fake/direct/routed evaluation. Routed calls combine system/account preferences and may call the secondary configured provider once.
items.actor: Application evaluation caller; account holder or administrator maintaining preference
items.goal: Evaluate input using configured capability and return actual provider/model provenance.
items.trigger: LanguageEvaluationPort.evaluate or evaluateWithProvenance with optional routing userId/requiredProvider.
preconditions: Live credentials configured; presence does not establish remote availability.
mainFlow: Fake languageEvaluation.provider returns fake adapter before routing logic.
Routing disabled selects configured direct OpenAI-compatible or Discovery adapter.
Routing enabled registers configured live providers and resolves system/account preference.
Combine environment/system/account fallback permissions; requiredProvider overrides preference.
Call primary; OpenAI-compatible uses /responses structured output, Discovery /chat/completions with parsed/schema-validated JSON.
For allowed ProviderError and enabled fallback, call other registered provider once and return actual provider/model/config provenance.
alternativeFlows: Invalid/missing account preference uses system preference.
Settings updates reject routing disabled/unavailable selection; system changes can audit transactionally.
exceptionFlows: No alternate for requiredProvider, disabled fallback, missing secondary, non-ProviderError, refusal, invalid audio or expired recording.
Missing primary registration throws non-retryable PROVIDER_UPSTREAM but can still fall back when not required, because router does not test retryable.
Adapters reject refusal and malformed/incomplete output; HTTP helper maps timeout/status/response bounds.
postconditions: Source/settings shape does not prove running provider selection.
businessRules: Fallback predicate uses class/code/settings rather than retryable flag.
acceptanceCriteria: INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Fallback does not loop if both providers fail.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Required-provider work never downgrades.
INFERRED acceptance criterion from source: Concurrent accounts retain separate actual provider provenance.

items.name: Normalized registration and learner defaults
items.description: Registration trims identity, lowercases email and requires a 12–128 character password at DTO boundary; Prisma defaults create LEARNER/ACTIVE.

items.name: Session token and account validity
items.description: Persist HMAC-SHA256 token hash, reject revoked/expired sessions and non-ACTIVE users. Session lifetime is seven days; logout revokes matching unrevoked token hashes.

items.name: Method role override and any-role matching
items.description: Handler role metadata overrides class metadata. Missing/empty role list passes; otherwise any matching role is enough. Insufficient administrative permission throws ForbiddenException.

items.name: Preferences use authenticated identity
items.description: Optional mismatched x-worklingo-account-id fails ACCOUNT_CHANGED. Preference lookup/upsert uses authUser.id; missing/unsupported stored locale projects as vi.

items.name: Draft edits use revision compare-and-set
items.description: Published/archived imports are immutable through edit/validate. Edit requires expected revision and DRAFT/VALIDATED status, increments once, sets DRAFT and clears validationHash.

items.name: Validation binds hash and blocking issues
items.description: Conditional validation matches ID/revision/hash/editable status. Only canPublish sets VALIDATED and validationHash=sourceHash. Analyzer checks source length above 500000 characters, section/activity limits 200/50 and listening audio references; controller distinguishes parse/validation errors.

items.name: Publication serializes allocation and replay
items.description: Actor/operation/key receipt, slug advisory transaction lock and import row lock protect publication. It rechecks revision/hash/state, materializes children, archives prior current, changes pointer and commits audit/receipt together.

items.name: Listening binds explicit current READY candidates
items.description: Selected IDs are distinct; each required script selects artifact from this import with matching slug, READY and exact script hash. Extraneous selected slugs fail. Transaction rechecks candidates before version binding.

items.name: Audio replay and freshness are separate
items.description: Generation request hash includes import/script selector/provider/voice/canonical config. Matching receipt replays acceptance. Pre/post synthesis script mismatch yields STALE; READY update requires GENERATING artifact.

items.name: Job replay checks identity rather than payload equality
items.description: Enqueue skips duplicate key and confirms creator/type/resourceType/resourceId. It does not compare payload, contentImportId or maxAttempts against existing row.

items.name: Claim locks and owner-attempt fences
items.description: Due PENDING/RETRY_WAIT needs remaining attempts; expired RUNNING is reclaimable. Claims use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Completion/failure matches RUNNING/owner/attempt but not wall-clock lease expiry.

items.name: Bounded code-specific retry
items.description: Runner requires retryable ProviderError and helper approval. Timeout/rate-limit/upstream retry below max; invalid/refused helper codes are eligible only at attempt 1. Delay starts at exponential 1s with 0.8–1.2 jitter, honors retryAfterMs within 60s cap. Live adapters mark refusals non-retryable, so their refusals never enter helper retry.

items.name: Owner manual retry grants one attempt
items.description: Status/retry API requires CONTENT_ADMIN or SYSTEM_ADMIN; service filters creator. Manual retry conditionally accepts FAILED/retryable, preserves identity, adds one maxAttempts unit and clears completion/errors.

items.name: Fixed-window limiting applies only to decorated operations
items.description: No RateLimit metadata bypasses guard. Decorated calls use HMAC subject hashes and PostgreSQL upsert by scope/hash/window; excess is 429 with rate-limit/retry headers. Login/register each declare 30 per 60 seconds.

items.name: Fallback is constrained independently of retryable flag
items.description: Required provider overrides preference. Account fallback cannot override system prohibition. One alternate requires enabled fallback, registered secondary and ProviderError other than refusal/invalid-audio/expired-recording; retryable flag is not tested.

items.name: Account registration and session identity
items.description: Expose public learner registration/login, projected current-user identity and current-session logout with DTO password/locale validation.

items.name: Active session and administrative authorization

items.name: Login and protected request sequence
items.description: Successful login and protected identity request with explicit error alternatives. Global guard wiring is source evidence, not a deployed execution trace.
items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Account
    participant Auth as AuthController and AuthService
    participant DB as Prisma User and UserSession
    participant Guard as SessionAuthGuard and RolesGuard
    participant Users as UsersController
    Account->>Auth: POST /api/v1/auth/login
    Auth->>DB: Find normalized email and profile
    alt Missing user, bad password or inactive account
        Auth-->>Account: 401 credential error
    else Valid credentials
        Auth->>DB: Store token hash and expiry
        Auth-->>Account: Public user and session cookie
        Account->>Guard: GET /api/v1/me with cookie
        Guard->>DB: Find token hash and current user
        alt Session absent, revoked, expired or account inactive
            Guard-->>Account: 401
        else Valid session
            Guard->>Guard: Check required roles when declared
            Guard->>Users: Attach authenticated user
            Users-->>Account: Current user
        end
    end

items.name: Durable job transitions
items.description: Only JobsService/registered runner transitions shown. RUNNING self-transition is lease reclamation with new attempt; COMPLETED does not guarantee an audio artifact is READY.
items.code:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> PENDING: enqueue with schema default
    PENDING --> RUNNING: due and attempts below max
    RETRY_WAIT --> RUNNING: due and attempts below max
    RUNNING --> RUNNING: lease expired and attempts below max
    RUNNING --> FAILED: lease expired at max attempts
    RUNNING --> COMPLETED: matching owner and attempt succeeds
    RUNNING --> RETRY_WAIT: matching claim and eligible provider retry
    RUNNING --> FAILED: matching claim and no automatic retry
    FAILED --> PENDING: owner retry when retryable adds one attempt

items.name: Publication and explicit archive sequence
items.description: Preflight checks precede transaction locks, rereads and atomic materialization/pointer/audit/receipt updates.
items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Admin
    participant Publisher as ContentPublisherService
    participant DB as PostgreSQL transaction
    Admin->>Publisher: Publish import, revision, hash, key and audio choices
    Publisher->>DB: Read mutation receipt
    alt Matching replay receipt
        DB-->>Publisher: Saved response
        Publisher-->>Admin: Original response
    else New request
        Publisher->>Publisher: Check validated source and selected READY audio
        Publisher->>DB: Begin transaction and acquire lesson slug lock
        Publisher->>DB: Recheck receipt and row-lock import
        Publisher->>DB: Recheck revision, hash, validation and audio
        Publisher->>DB: Allocate version and materialize children
        Publisher->>DB: Bind selected audio
        Publisher->>DB: Archive prior current and publish new version
        Publisher->>DB: Change lesson pointer and import status
        Publisher->>DB: Write audit and receipt, commit
        Publisher-->>Admin: Published version identity
    end
    opt Explicit archive of published version
        Admin->>Publisher: Archive version
        Publisher->>DB: Slug lock and reread version
        Publisher->>DB: Archive, clear pointer if current, audit and commit
        Publisher-->>Admin: ARCHIVED
    end

items.name: Durable audio generation activity
items.description: Handler returns STALE normally for script changes. Terminal/exhausted errors attempt artifact FAILED and rethrow for runner policy.
items.code:
flowchart TD
    Claim[GENERATE_AUDIO claim] --> Parse[Parse payload and fetch script]
    Parse --> Fresh{Script hash matches?}
    Fresh -->|No| Stale[Mark GENERATING artifact STALE]
    Fresh -->|Yes| Candidate[Resolve provider and GENERATING candidate]
    Candidate --> Synth[Synthesize and store audio]
    Synth --> Recheck{Latest script hash matches?}
    Recheck -->|Yes| Ready[Update artifact to READY]
    Recheck -->|No| Changed[Update artifact to STALE]
    Ready --> Result[Return status to runner]
    Changed --> Result
    Stale --> Result
    Candidate -.-> Err[Error caught in handler]
    Synth -.-> Err
    Err --> Terminal{Non-retryable or attempt budget exhausted?}
    Terminal -->|Yes| Failed[Attempt artifact FAILED]
    Terminal -->|No| Retain[Retain artifact state]
    Failed --> Throw[Rethrow to runner]
    Retain --> Throw

items.name: Routed evaluation fallback decision
items.description: Only routed adapter path is shown; fake/direct construction bypasses it. No retryable-flag gate is invented.
items.code:

items.name: README no-cloud description versus live AI routing
items.description: README describes a self-contained slice without cloud/third-party AI dependencies. Architecture depicts outbound providers but names OpenAI-compatible/Microsoft STT/configurable TTS without Discovery/account routing. Current factories support fake, direct OpenAI/Discovery and a two-provider router. The README statement fits fake mode rather than all supported configurations.
items.documentedClaim: Self-contained operation without cloud or third-party AI dependencies.
items.observedBehavior: Live providers and system/account fallback are implemented alongside default fake mode.
unknowns: Active environment and deployed provider selection intentionally not examined.

items.name: Claim fencing does not prove side-effect exclusivity
items.description: Completion/failure predicates match status/owner/attempt rather than leaseExpiresAt. Reviewed runner has no lease renewal or cancellation path; an expired handler could continue after another claim. External/domain writes therefore cannot be assumed exactly once. Configuration lengthens lease to at least three provider timeouts plus 10 seconds when evaluation/STT is live.
unknowns: Overlapping side effects after expiry were not reproduced.
Expired but not reclaimed job can still complete because expiry is absent from update predicate.

items.name: Timer serialization is not global concurrency configuration
items.description: pollActive serializes only private timer poll. AudioGenerationService calls public runOnce in a bounded loop outside that flag; runOnce has no enabled check or concurrency gate. Database locks protect claims, but a fixed global concurrency of one cannot be inferred.
unknowns: Actual concurrency depends on request/process overlap and was not measured.
workerEnabled controls timer startup rather than direct runOnce calls.

items.name: Manual job retry does not reset FAILED audio candidate
items.description: Terminal/exhausted audio failure marks artifact FAILED. retryJob resets Job fields only, while the handler requires its existing candidate to be GENERATING. A retryable job may therefore be scheduled without its failed artifact becoming eligible again. This consequence is inferred across code paths and not reproduced.
unknowns: Exhausted-audio manual retry was not executed; a fresh generation request can create a new candidate.

items.name: Publication request hash omits import identity
items.description: Publication receipt lookup uses actor/operation/key; request hash includes revision/hash/key/audio selection but omits importId. Receipt replay precedes import lookup. Cross-import requests with otherwise identical hashed fields could replay another import response. Audio generation includes contentImportId in its hash.
unknowns: Cross-import replay scenario not exercised; no incident claimed.

items.name: Transport and deployment guarantees remain unknown
items.description: Source cookie secure=false is unconditional. API and development Compose database bind loopback; Next forwards to configured API origin. These sources do not establish deployed TLS, proxy trust, hostname, process count or filesystem permissions.
verifiedFacts: Cookie secure flag is false in source.
API and development database bind loopback.
unknowns: Active deployment and environment configuration intentionally excluded.

items.name: Job correlation and rate-limit cleanup scheduling are unverified
items.description: Architecture describes request/job correlation IDs. Middleware and HTTP errors carry request IDs; runner warnings include job ID and safe code but no request correlation propagation in the reviewed path. Rate-limit cleanup is an injectable one-day-default method; reviewed source search found no production caller or scheduler.
verifiedFacts: Request correlation and safe structured logger implementations exist.
Cleanup method exists, but not a scheduler in its class.
unknowns: External scheduling, operational retention and complete request-to-job correlation unverified.

items.name: Cross-resource backup snapshot consistency not established
items.description: Architecture describes database/directory backup as one logical snapshot. Script creates dump before copying files and hashing bundle. Reviewed sequence does not demonstrate application-write freezing or coordinated database/file snapshot. Integrity/empty-target checks exist; concurrent consistency remains unknown.
